scope: Slovak hint accuracy and alignment with the selected Spanish sense; no audio review.

entries.notes: Dôkladne posúdiť and starostlivo zvážiť hodnotu preserve careful assessment of testimonial worth; neither implies assaying metal or proving the accusation.
Rozhodnúť spor and vyriešiť spornú otázku express resolution of competing positions and fit the commission deciding the disputed issue.
Presne rozlíšiť captures the conceptual boundary between political and administrative responsibility; vymedziť is a useful supporting gloss without implying acquittal.
Vyvodiť and usúdiť z indícií preserve inference rather than knowledge; the Spanish negation correctly denies that silence licenses the conclusion.
Obísť otázku is exact for evasive answering; vyhnúť sa riešeniu supports avoiding engagement without confusing the sense with preventing harm.
Výhrada and obmedzujúce spresnenie preserve qualified assent, including the dependency of dates on permission, without implying wholesale rejection.
Bez okolkov is idiomatic Slovak for direct speech; priamo is supported by the no-evasion definition and does not add hostility.
Jemne rozlišovať and dôkladne rozoberať detaily fit distinguishing criticism of a method from attacking its user; metaphor is not translated literally.
The Slovak hint correctly selects excessive complication in the signatures example, but the Spanish definition also admits neutral refinement. Narrow the Spanish sense so the fields agree.

findings.suggestedReplacement: Añadir a algo una complicación innecesaria.
findings.reason: Align with the unnecessary-complication sense already selected by the example and Slovak hint.

entries.notes: Naraziť na seberovného súpera fits the negotiator meeting effective resistance; nájsť si svojho majstra supplies an idiomatic counterpart without literal shoe imagery.
Vypočítavý zámer preserves calculated self-interest in mentioning the vacancy to the director, rather than simply acting carefully or sewing literally.
The hint retains seeking benefit while avoiding accompanying risk; it fits supporting the protest privately without public commitment.
Prihrievať si vlastnú polievočku is an idiomatic counterpart to self-serving advocacy; the first gloss explains the benefit without literal fire imagery.
Dodatočne, keď je už výsledok známy preserves hindsight and resolved uncertainty; the example supplies the ironic claim that everyone already knew.

The causal reading is present, but pre svoju vlastnosť is an opaque generic phrase and tým, že bol fixes masculine past-tense wording not inherent in the expression. Provide an intelligible causal gloss.

findings.suggestedReplacement: pre určitú vlastnosť (napr. z opatrnosti); vzhľadom na to, že je
findings.reason: Clarify causal quality reading without freezing the expression to masculine past tense.

entries.notes: V záujme is exact, but vyššieho cieľa adds the idea of an elevated or morally superior purpose. The Spanish only prioritizes a purpose.

findings.suggestedReplacement: v záujme; v prospech uprednostneného cieľa
findings.reason: Avoid implying moral superiority of the purpose.

entries.notes: Vzhľadom na and berúc do úvahy both preserve considering an already expired deadline; neither implies automatic causal inevitability.
Navyše correctly adds corroboration, and na ďalšie podporenie argumentu explains its formal argumentative function; the missing date correspondence adds a separate reinforcing reason.
Ak dovolíte tú významovú nadbytočnosť functions as a metalinguistic acknowledgement seeking tolerance for the redundant wording, matching the example.
S dovolením is natural and the explicit formal request-for-floor parenthesis preserves the ceremonial register rather than implying agreement.
Bez presvedčenia is precise for weakly voiced support; len neochotne remains compatible in this example though reluctance alone would not define the full expression.
The hint preserves both causing harm/conflict and hiding responsibility. Vlastnú účasť is understood as culpable involvement through the first clause.
Teraz tvrdia pravý opak narrows retraction to exact contradiction, and obracajú podľa potreby hard-codes expediency. The expression can mark backing away from an earlier assertion more generally.

findings.suggestedReplacement: beriem späť, čo som povedal; teraz už tvrdím niečo iné
findings.reason: Allow retraction or changed assertion without requiring exact logical opposite.

entries.notes: Múdremu stačí naznačiť is a natural proverb equivalent and keeps inference from a hint; the threatening force is correctly supplied by the contract-renewal context.
Akoby and zdanlivou preserve apparent casualness and leave room for actual intent; the job question demonstrates the indirect maneuver.
Ak nie rovno and aby som nepovedal naturally introduce the stronger accusation while presenting it as restrained; neither reads as literal prohibition on speaking.
Premôcť sa is particularly apt for congratulating a rival despite disappointment; the second gloss retains courage plus inner resistance without suggesting emotional absence.
Udržiavať si odstup vo vzťahu preserves interpersonal reserve, not physical distance, and fits maintaining a professional authority boundary.
The Slovak causal purpose clause preserves accommodation to avoid conflict; it does not imply endorsement of either party’s accusations.
Urážlivosť precisely captures readiness to take offense. Precitlivenosť na kritiku narrows the supporting gloss appropriately to the carefully framed objection example.

Pretrvávajúca horkosť accurately retains lingering resentment despite accepting an apology. Zvyšková nevôľa is intelligible but slightly technical in collocation; optional smoother second gloss: pretrvávajúca nevôľa.
Nevraživosť and nepriateľský odpor preserve hostility toward the author rather than intellectual disagreement with the book.
Drobné písmo evokes the established contractual image, while the explanatory gloss prevents confusing physical font size with the consequential conditions sense.
Skrytá vada is the appropriate lexical counterpart for a defect not apparent in ordinary examination. This is language correspondence, not verification of jurisdiction-specific legal rights.
Zostať len na papieri is idiomatic and nemať praktický účinok explains lack of implementation; Spanish puede correctly leaves failure as a possibility.
Naťahovať vybavenie výhovorkami retains deliberate stalling; odkladať odpoveď is anchored by that first gloss and the repeated changing explanations.
Vedome privrieť oči nad prehreškom is idiomatic and explicitly preserves intentional tolerance rather than accidental failure to notice.
Spochybniť dôveryhodnosť či platnosť accurately fits contradictory invoices undermining the company account; the example does not demand an additional reputation gloss.
Presne vzaté and v prísnom zmysle preserve strict formulation, especially association versus causality, without suggesting secrecy.
Both Slovak phrases preserve the remaining possibility of later revision and do not imply that the provisional text causes damage. The gloss is tailored to the selected example.
The explanatory second gloss precisely identifies assuming what must be proved; logický kruh is a familiar learner aid and is disambiguated by that explanation.
The paraphrase identifies refuting a distorted version of another position and avoids a literal straw-man translation. The example preserves regulation versus absolute prohibition.
Úspornosť vysvetlenia and minimum potrebných predpokladov match the explanatory-economy sense, rather than slowness, stinginess or low evidence quality.

The core zdanlivý/nepravý is suitable, but vzťah bez skutočného podkladu can mislead here: a third variable can explain a real statistical association while the claimed direct causal link is unsupported. Clarify selected relationship in both languages.

findings.suggestedReplacement: zdanlivý; nepravý (vzťah, ktorý sa javí ako skutočný)
findings.reason: Avoid denying any genuine association or underlying explanation; coordinate with Spanish review of the exact technical example.

entries.notes: Útočiť na toho, kto už padol preserves attacking a weakened person; zneužívať cudzie nešťastie is anchored by that precise first gloss and the mocking-ruin example.
Dymová clona is a natural figurative equivalent and the explanatory second gloss captures concealment through distraction; the Spanish appearance marker leaves intention uncertain.
The Slovak description preserves grand display without practical prospect and avoids literal toasting; the funding and timing omissions motivate that evaluation.
Lákavý, ale klamlivý či nebezpečný prísľub retains attraction plus deception/danger; the selected guaranteed-return example specifically supports the promise wording.
Oslavný prejav či text names the praise genre and chválospev is a useful equivalent; neither makes every instance necessarily insincere despite the critical example.
Hanobenie and prudká slovná hana retain forceful personal censure without requiring obscenity. Hana is literary in tone and suitable to the formal headword; direct JULS corroboration was unavailable.

method: Independent AI comparison of every Slovak hint with its Spanish definition and example. Contextual paraphrases are evaluated as sense hints, not full sentence translations. No human, native-speaker or official level approval is claimed.
